title: A Bell Experiment in an Entangled Universe
summary: We propose a possible quantum signature of the early Universe that could lead to observational imprints of the quantum nature of the inflationary period. Graviton production from the presence of a classical, coherent state of the inflaton scalar field results in entangled states in the gravitons' polarizations.
